summary: Sprint 2 'Make Assistify Feel Alive' verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 tests pass (test_sprint2_ai.py) — /api/ai/activities (backfill + idempotent), /time-saved (int keys, monotonic ordering), /activities/history (grouped Today/Yesterday/This Week/Earlier with total_time_saved sum), /insights (rules + cached LLM polish, cache hits <10s, all required fields), /notifications (mixed insight+completion items), and doc-generate endpoints (proposal=23, plan=15, contract=12, invoice=6) each log a corresponding ai_activity with correct time_saved. Frontend: dashboard-ai-assistant renders at top with greeting 'Good morning, Jordan 👋', completed list (4 items backfilled), 'Time saved today 56 min', 'View all activity' link, ai-insights block with 2 proactive insights ('Suggested follow-up ready', 'Project may be blocked'); dashboard KPIs/charts still render below unchanged; notifications bell dropdown titled 'Assistify notifications' shows 8 rich notification-item entries with icon+title+message; user-menu 'AI History' item and 'View all activity' link both navigate to /ai-history which renders grouped entries with '+Nm saved' badges and total '2h 18m'; Generate Proposal shows ai-workflow / proposal-generating panel with staged steps then renders the full proposal (Executive Summary, Client Goals, etc.). No regressions detected — dashboard/summary, copilot suggestions, project workspace generation/save all healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_activity.py TIME_SAVED values are hard-coded; consider moving to config so product can tune without code deploy.

routers/ai.py _polish blocks the request when the LLM is available and cache expires — safe (has try/except and fallback), but consider firing polish in a background task on first miss so the initial /insights call is always fast.

server.py is now ~1900+ lines and hosts generate_* endpoints along with everything else — extract per-doc-type endpoints into routers/proposal.py, routers/contract.py, routers/invoice.py, routers/plan.py to stay under the 700-line guideline.
ai_activities collection has no index on (organizationId, created_at) — history/activities queries will slow as data grows; add compound index.

ensure_backfill flag lives on the organizations doc; if a doc is generated later and the org has ai_backfilled=True but a manual DB restore drops ai_activities, the backfill won't re-run. Consider basing idempotency on a counter or checksum instead.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_Sprint2 AI Project created in jordan's org during backend test run — contains generated proposal/plan/contract/invoice. Left in place so main agent can inspect; safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite: /app/backend/tests/test_sprint2_ai.py (13 tests, ~60s). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env fallback. Prior suites still green (test_p1_launch, test_copilot_branding, test_email_delivery, test_demo_and_billing). Note register/demo/forgot share a 10/hr/IP rate limit — restart backend if 429s appear. Live AI workflow stages are intentionally frontend-animated (single backend request); verify the panel appears + real content renders — do not treat stage text as backend-driven. Legacy test_proposal.py / test_planner.py remain pre-auth and should be ignored.
